# Brand Fonts Directory

Place brand font files here:
- `OPPOSans-Regular.woff2` (or .woff / .ttf)
- `OPPOSans-Medium.woff2` (or .woff / .ttf)
- `OPPOSans-Bold.woff2` (or .woff / .ttf)
- `BrandDisplay-Bold.woff2` (or .woff / .ttf)

The application automatically includes `@font-face` rules for these in `src/index.css`.
Fallback system fonts (`system-ui`, `-apple-system`, `sans-serif`) are active by default.
